answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 25996 Country: India Title: My sister-in-law has a baby of three months at the start of ramzan she started keeping fast and she or the baby had no problem but her mother who is islamic teacher in dubai told her that one shoudnt keep fast while feeding and she stoped fasting.is it correct that one shoudnt keep fast while feeding the baby. Question: ask my sister-in-law has a baby of three months at the start of ramzan she started keeping fast and she or the baby had no problem but her mother who is islamic teacher in dubai told her that one shoudnt keep fast while feeding and she stoped fasting.is it correct that one shoudnt keep fast while feeding the baby. Answer ID: 25996 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2104/H=620/th=1431) If there was no problem, the mas'ala said by the Islamic teacher was not right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
